headline: Cho Jung-tai: Accelerate the Minimum Wage Adjustment Process, Firmly Support SMEs' Transformation | Politics
summary: Taiwan's minimum wage will rise to a monthly salary of NT$30,900 and an hourly wage of NT$205. Premier Cho Jung-tai said the government will speed up the adjustment process and invest NT$25 billion annually from next year.
why: Minimum wage increases raise labour costs for low-wage employers, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises, and affect consumer spending and inflation.
